findings.stock_path: aw_i2c_probe returns 0 after workqueue/RTP/pages allocation failure without setting g_aw_haptic; misc_register and Richtap work initialization are only on complete path
findings.risk: remove previously called misc_deregister on a zero-initialized misc list and canceled work items that were not initialized
findings.fix: remove gates misc deregistration on tracked successful registration, base/optional work cancellation on initialized state, and buffer free on publication; partial state is tracked until remove and blocks a second singleton probe
findings.residual: The stock probe still returns success for partial initialization; the candidate contains the teardown and singleton hazard but does not convert the degraded bind into a probe error.

findings.stock_path: probe calls devm_gpio_request_one for both lines and later calls gpio_free at assembly offsets 0x4f74 and 0x4f80; remove also manually frees both
evidence: Docker source: drivers/gpio/gpiolib-legacy.c devm_gpio_release; drivers/gpio/gpiolib.c gpiod_free
findings.risk: manual gpio_free leaves devres actions armed; later release calls gpio_free again and drops GPIO module/device references twice
findings.fix: probe cleanup call instructions are NOPs and remove no longer frees managed GPIOs; devres performs one release after probe failure or remove.

findings.stock_path: irq_config records skip state in state+0x15 bit 0; allocation-failure cleanup calls devm_free_irq only after private workqueue exists; ram_work_init and Richtap work init are conditional
findings.fix: probe IRQ cleanup wrapper honors skip bit; remove frees IRQ only when requested and not already released by allocation cleanup; RAM delayed work is canceled only if workqueue creation passed; Richtap work offsets are canceled only for published state.

findings.stock_path: pages allocation failure frees state+0x608 but leaves the field non-NULL before returning 0
findings.fix: remove skips kfree(state+0x608) for unpublished partial state; complete published state retains normal free.
